## Change

Describe the concrete behavior and why it changes.

## Evidence and checks

- [ ] Both quality commands pass.
- [ ] Public assets and private research material remain separated.
- [ ] Any changed factual/asset baseline has an exact before/after evidence map.
- [ ] Relevant browser/phone checks and their limits are recorded for UI changes.
- [ ] No existing notes were inspected, migrated or overwritten.

For a checkpoint, include stage, remaining milestones/checkpoint range and scoped
active-work ETA, separating research from website/release progress.
